title: An unrecognised kind of organization is refused, not approximated
proves: The two governance questions -- who can adopt a policy, and which third-party agreements bind the data -- have different correct answers per vertical. Matching an unknown organization to the nearest profile would silently apply a governing-authority rule nobody designed for it, which is how an engagement ends up unauthorized while every box is ticked.
